title: Invoice generator input
description: Every field is optional; missing ones fall back to the template defaults. Files passed to the CLI merge left to right (seller profile, client, document).

docType.description: Document type; decides the title and which sections show. export_invoice is an invoice for export of services in a foreign currency: TAX INVOICE with the Rule 46 endorsement when fromGstin is set, plain INVOICE without GST details when it is not

fromTag.description: Text under the title, e.g. UNREGISTERED or GSTIN: 23ABCDE1234F1Z5

fromGstin.description: Seller GSTIN, if GST-registered; checked with its check digit, printed under the address, and used by taxMode auto; on an export invoice it decides between a tax invoice with the Rule 46 endorsement and a plain invoice

toGstin.description: Client GSTIN, if the client is GST-registered; checked with its check digit

invNo.description: Document number, e.g. INV/2627/01; never reuse one

due.description: a date as YYYY-MM-DD, or empty

place.description: Place of supply: a state name (Karnataka) or GST state code (29, 29-Karnataka). A bare code prints as "Karnataka (29)". On an export invoice, defaults to Outside India

taxMode.description: none prints Tax N/A; cgst_sgst splits taxRate in half per line (odd paisa to SGST); igst charges taxRate; auto picks from the seller's GSTIN state and place: same state cgst_sgst (UTGST in a Union territory), different igst, no seller GSTIN none. Ignored on export invoices (see exportMode)

ifsc.description: an 11-character IFSC like ICIC0001190, or empty

refInvoice.description: Original invoice number (receipts, credit and debit notes)

refDate.description: a date as YYYY-MM-DD, or empty

payMode.description: Payment mode, e.g. UPI, NEFT, Cash (receipts)

notes.description: Free text below the amount in words

upiQr.description: Show a pay-by-UPI QR (invoices, proformas, debit notes); needs upiId

upiId.description: a UPI ID like name@okicici, or empty

upiName.description: Payee name in the UPI app; defaults to fromName

currency.description: a 3-letter currency code like USD (export invoices; item rates are in this currency)

exchangeRate.description: Rupees per one unit of currency, e.g. 83.5 (export invoices); printed with its source and date

exchangeRateSource.description: Where the exchange rate comes from, e.g. RBI reference rate (export invoices)

exchangeRateDate.description: a date as YYYY-MM-DD, or empty (the exchange rate's date; required on export invoices)

buyerCountry.description: Country of the buyer, printed as the country of destination (export invoices)

exportMode.description: Export invoices from a GST-registered seller (fromGstin): lut (under Letter of Undertaking, without IGST) or igst_paid (on payment of IGST at taxRate); picks the Rule 46 endorsement. Leave out (or empty) when the seller is not registered

lut.description: Letter of Undertaking for exportMode lut (registered sellers only; leave out otherwise)

arn.description: ARN of the LUT filed on the GST portal (FORM GST RFD-11)

fy.description: a financial year like 2026-27, or empty

tds.description: Receipts: rupees of income tax the client deducted at source from this payment. Not printed; read by the receivables tool

tdsSection.description: Rule id from rules/tds-sections.json the client deducts TDS under, e.g. professional_fees (the CLI checks it against that file). Not printed; read by the receivables tool
